preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain owner privileges) to call includeInReward()
At least two addresses must be in the _excluded array
The address to be included (removed from exclusion) must be in the _excluded array

exploit_hint: As owner, call includeInReward() on an excluded address that is NOT the last in the _excluded array. This will swap it with the last address but fail to update _excludedAddressToId for the swapped address, corrupting the mapping. Then call includeInReward() again on the corrupted address to cause array index issues or access wrong addresses.
